verdict.rationale: The official Vue site links to 'Get Security Updates for Vue 2' alongside a 'Migration from Vue 2' guide. That points to a first-party path for keeping an older major version patched while migrating. The evidence is only a navigation link title, with no detail on who provides the updates, their scope, duration or cost. missing for 10: details of the security-update offering (provider, terms, duration, coverage), confirmation it is ongoing, independent or hands-on corroboration that users receive the updates.
